rust_summary: opt-in state-aware native block entity factories.
doc_summary: `native_stateful_block_entity` declares static factory ownership; pure `native_block_entity_from_state` receives the borrowed actual block/property map. An empty result creates no new entity and never falls through to API15. LevelChunk mutation creates inline after onPlace; existing same-block entities survive state property changes. Bundles need "hooks": @API:state_block_entity_factory@.
